531456.name: Machine Gun
531456.description: Fires a Machine Gun at a single Nikke, dealing damage.

531457.name: Launch Raptures
531457.description: Indivilia summons Raptures. The summoned Raptures cannot be auto-targeted, and will proceed to self-destruct, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

531460.name: Point Laser
531460.description:
Fires lasers from body and pincers, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
The pincers can be destroyed.

531463.name: Overcharge
531463.description: Enhances her body, temporarily becoming immune to debuffs.

531465.name: Tail Laser
531465.description: Fires powerful lasers from the tail, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

531466.name: Pincer Wave
531466.description: Shoots a powerful laser from its pincer, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

531467.name: Super Quiver Blade
531467.description:
Whips all Nikkes with her tail, dealing damage.
Indivilia generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Super Quiver Blade. While the barrier is up, only Fire Code Nikkes can deal damage.

531468.name: All-Range Laser
531468.description: Fires a laser from its Core, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

531470.name: Head Laser
531470.description: Fires a powerful laser beam, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

531471.name: Head Rush
531471.description: Strikes with her head, piercing through cover and dealing damage to all Nikkes.

531474.name: Needle Projectile
531474.description:
Fires the needle missiles from both sides of its head, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Needle missiles can be intercepted.

531482.name: Piercing Laser
531482.description: Fires a laser from its Core, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
